---
title: "Template Management — AD-02"
labels: ["feature", "admin", "priority/2"]
assignees: []
---

As an Admin, I want to manage templates so I can support pilots with repeatable assets.

Acceptance criteria:
- CRUD for templates with metadata (tags, effort estimate, templateRef).
- Publish/unpublish controls and assignment to opportunities.
- Template versioning or change log (basic).
